name: yochef
description: YoChef rebuild (v2): Expo mobile app, Vite admin web, Supabase migrations.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix admin test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
